note: No public record of an Indian entity named 'Nakson Global' could be located. Research was materially constrained: the DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection errors (searx: Connection refused) for all queries; Bing exact-phrase queries for "Nakson Global" returned only unrelated results (no exact match), and follow-up queries returned generic noise; zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; tofler.in search returned HTTP 404. The OFAC Sanctions List Search page was reachable but is a JavaScript form whose query results cannot be retrieved via plain HTTP GET, so no name-level screening result could be obtained — sanctions_hit is therefore null (NOT screened, not 'clear'). No UN/EU/UK/BIS list lookup was possible either. No Indian court records (eCourts/NJDG), regulator actions, credit rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) or negative news could be retrieved, so all such fields are null — this reflects absence of accessible public data, not absence of risk. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found, but equally no shipment or customs/B-L records were retrievable, so rf_supply is null rather than a negative finding. Per project rules, no rejection is proposed on this basis; the company should be retained with status 'unverified / data not public'. Recommended next steps before any decision: (1) obtain the exact legal name and CIN/PAN from the counterparty and re-run screening against OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List via their downloadable list files rather than the JS search UI; (2) check eCourts/NJDG by party name once the legal entity is known; (3) verify GST registration status on the GST portal; (4) re-attempt trade-data checks (Volza/Export Genius/ImportYeti) for actual shipment records. Note also that the claimed industry ('Металлургия и горнодобыча' — metallurgy and mining) is inconsistent with the declared HS codes 841231 (machinery/mechanical parts), 847170 (data-processing storage units) and 847330 (computer parts), which is a data-quality flag for the HS/identity reviewer, not a risk finding.
